name: Inevitable Relations
source:
You are playing as Bethany, the mother of Charlie and Eva. Charlie and Eva were pretty close, too close for Beth and Alex, who Beth is married to. So they send Charlie to California, to live with Beth‘s brother Leo. After one year he returns, and the story starts there.

To say it with Beth‘s words: „I thought, if he lives with my brother for a few months, everything will be alright and their feelings would settle. Yeah right... Let's just say they did in a way.“

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/KinneyX23]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演贝瑟妮，查理与伊娃的母亲。查理和伊娃关系非常亲密，亲密到让贝瑟妮与丈夫亚历克斯感到不安。于是他们把查理送到加利福尼亚，与贝瑟妮的弟弟利奥一起生活。一年后，他回来了，故事也从此开始。

用贝瑟妮的话说：“我想，只要他和弟弟住几个月，一切就会好起来，他们的感情也会平静下来。对，才怪……只能说，确实以某种方式平静下来了。”

[来源：[url=https://www.patreon.com/KinneyX23]Patreon[/url]]
